title: The Borrowed Atlas
author: Marguerite Vane
blurb: Tamsin Fairweather, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
